summary: The East Central Regional Library, a rural public library system in Minnesota, strongly supports the E-Rate program and its role in ensuring public libraries have access to affordable, high-quality broadband connectivity. The library heavily relies on E-Rate support, currently receiving a 70% discount, which enables it to purchase broadband services.
